title: Re-grade the screening units recorded as base timeouts on a quiet host
body:
The t-8e4kdzz lane (#1329, 14f6df0) marked t-2blfi57 in evals/units/screening-manifest.json as baseFailure timeout instead of re-grading it, because host load was ~44; t-2ouowe0 and t-1ew29tn were relabelled timeout too (testBase 124). verify --recorded now prints 70, the minimum.
Outcome: on a quiet host (uptime load < 8) the three units are re-graded one at a time; each base either fails by assertion (verified again) or stays timeout with its measured duration recorded.
Proof: node evals/units/screening.ts verify --recorded prints >= 70 and names no unit whose testBase is 124.
